people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

translations.web: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
translations.bsb: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
